modeOn: Writing mode: pen writes, fingers pan. Exit to edit by touch
confirmClear: Clear all strokes on this document? You can still undo afterwards.
exportNone: No strokes on this document yet
exportInserted: Image inserted at the end of the document
saveRetry: Ink is retained in this session and saving will retry; keep this page open until connectivity returns
settingShowFloatingBallHint: When hidden, use the desktop top bar or command to toggle drawing; on mobile, restore the button in plugin settings
settingMouseDrawingHint: Off: the mouse edits while the stylus draws. If a tablet driver reports only mouse events, enable Windows Ink/pen mode first, or enable this fallback (the browser cannot distinguish that tablet from a real mouse)
settingDoubleTapHint: Quickly tap the page twice with the stylus, not the pen barrel. Disable when writing dots or punctuation
settingPenWidthMaxHint: Maximum of the width slider on the toolbar; default 20
settingShapeSnapHint: Pause briefly after drawing a line, rectangle, triangle or ellipse and it snaps to a perfect shape (GoodNotes-style); move again to keep drawing freehand
